d: Kendriy grih mantri amit shah (Amit Shah) ne somvar ko midiya ke durdarshi ramoji rav (Ramoji Rao) ki tariph ki. unhonne kaha ki bharat men koee bhi desh ke lie unke yogdan ki barabri nahin kar sakta. yahan do. biaar anbedkar kalavedika men ramoji eksilens avards 2026 ( Ramoji Excellence Awards 2026) karyakram ke mukhy atithi ke taur par logon ko sanbodhit karte hue, shah ne yad kiya ki kaise ramoji rav apne aap men ek sanstha the, jinki virasat unke jane ke bad bhi desh ko prerna deti hai.
